VSebCode deliberately uses a narrower adaptation: @vscode/vsce-sign is absent from the root runtime dependencies and root lockfile (build-tool dependencies are a separate scope); failed optional module loading returns undefined; the native install gate accepts undefined without labeling it Success. Archive/manifest identity validation remains.

effect: Adds application-scoped commands.filters with ask/off/on values, default-denies workbench.action.terminal.newLocal, updates its cached filter when configuration changes, rejects off, prompts Yes/No for ask and allows on/unlisted commands through CommandService. Test hunks adapt constructor setup but do not add behavioral filter assertions. VSebCode has no filter setting, cache or prompt; NewLocal is registered and creates a terminal.
